sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select name,owner,currency,total_cents,expires,stale,discount_review,bundle_gaps from quote_attention order by name

sections.title: Discount decisions
sections.sql: select name,owner,currency,net_cents,margin_cents,max_discount_bps from quote_totals where max_discount_bps>1000 order by name

sections.title: Bundle gaps
sections.sql: select name,bundle,missing_sku,missing_quantity from bundle_gaps order by name

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select name,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by name,rule
sections.note: Record checks for the responsible operator. Not legal certification.
